title: Config, minus the chatter
hints: README → New syntax: two sed commands chained with `-e`: a substitution, then `d`.
First erase optional spaces + `#` + the rest of the line. Whole-line comments become empty lines, so then delete empty lines.
`sed -e 's/[[:space:]]*#.*//' -e '...' "$DATA/services.conf"`: the second command deletes empty lines.
